facts.text: Through Concordia University Chicago's Prepared to Serve guarantee, new full-time students pursuing a church professional degree pay a maximum of $5,000 in tuition and mandatory fees each academic year beginning fall 2025.

sources.title: Concordia-Chicago announces church professional student tuition guarantee | Concordia University Chicago
sources.quote: Beginning fall 2025, new, full-time students pursuing a church professional degree will pay a maximum of $5,000 in tuition and mandatory fees each academic year.
